CustomField.description: Booking value including VAT and separately rounded staff top-ups. Bookings needing a pricing check are excluded.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(NTE_Pricing_Ready__c), NULL, IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Amount)), Amount > 0), Amount, NTE_Total_Including_VAT__c) + NTE_Top_Up_Total_Inc_VAT__c)
CustomField.label: NTE Confirmed Value (inc VAT)
